Title: Generally Available: Azure SQL updates for early-July 2025

Body.Content:
In early-July 2025, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL:  

  • Enhanced server audit for Azure SQL Database boosts performance, availability, and reliability. Learn more.  

  • Server audit action groups are now available to achieve compliance and feature parity in Azure SQL Database. Learn more.
